title: Study mode
summary: Read a lesson, check yourself and practise.
focus: Reading, the reading check and the Study mode tabs
content:
## Read a lesson

Open **Study mode** from the course home page. The **Lessons** tab lists the lessons, one unit at a time. Open one and read it from top to bottom.

At the end there is a reading check of two questions. Answer them to mark the lesson as read. Then you can practise it.

## The tabs

- **Lessons**: the list of lessons.
- **Practice**: quizzes drawn from the lessons you have read, weak topics first.
- **Map**: every lesson in order with your mastery, and a mark for where you are.
- **Vocabulary**: the words you have collected, as flashcards.
- **History**: every answer and every finished game.
- **Mistakes**: questions you got wrong lately.

A **Listening** tab shows up only in a language course.

## Mistakes and notes

A question leaves **Mistakes** when you answer it right.

Each lesson page has a **My note** box. It holds a private note of up to 500 characters and saves as you type.
